review_notes: I read the whole file and the definition of thetaL in Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_QExpansionDiff.lean. I also grepped the repo for other uses of coeff_thetaL and thetaL_one. The file declares no @[simp] lemmas and has no competing or looping simp rules. Its few simp calls are `simp` in coeff_thetaL_iterate, `simp only` with explicit lemma lists, and `simp_rw`. I found no unwanted expansion or cycle. The only issue I found is a missing canonical simp lemma. It is a modest, judgement-based finding. I could not run Lean, so I have not checked that the proposed attribute and the shortened proofs compile or that they cause no downstream simp side effects.

findings.declaration: CartierQExp.coeff_thetaL (with thetaL_one, thetaL_C, thetaL_single, coeff_thetaL_iterate, coeff_projP)
findings.excerpt:
theorem coeff_thetaL (f : LaurentSeries K) (n : ℤ) :
    (thetaL K f).coeff n = (n : K) * f.coeff n := by
findings.problem: coeff_thetaL is the one basic coefficient formula for the derivation thetaL, but it is not tagged @[simp]. The same holds for the related coefficient formulas coeff_thetaL_iterate and coeff_projP. thetaL_apply in the Definitions file is not simp either, so nothing else fires on `(thetaL K f).coeff n`. The result is that every consumer has to name the lemma by hand. Inside this file the small derived lemmas thetaL_one, thetaL_C and thetaL_single are each proved by the same `ext n; rw [coeff_thetaL, ...]; split_ifs; rw [h]; push_cast; ring` script. They are also not simp lemmas. Other files list coeff_thetaL by hand in `simp only [coeff_thetaL, ...]`, and one writes `simp [thetaL_one]` for a fact that a simp set would supply. So the simp interface for thetaL/projP coefficients is missing.
findings.proposed_change: Mark `coeff_thetaL` (and probably `coeff_thetaL_iterate`) with `@[simp]`. Its direction is safe. The LHS is a coefficient of `thetaL K f`, and the RHS is a cast times `f.coeff n`, which has no `thetaL` on it. So it cannot loop, and it does not conflict with any other thetaL rule I found. Also tag `thetaL_one`, `thetaL_C` and `thetaL_single` as `@[simp]`, since these are the normal forms of `thetaL` on 1, constants and monomials. Then thetaL_one and thetaL_C reduce to `ext n; simp [coeff_one]` or similar. Keep `coeff_projP` as an explicit rewrite lemma or make it simp only with care, because `projP_apply` unfolds to an iterate.
findings.benefit: `simp` could then compute coefficients of thetaL-expressions directly, so call sites would not list coeff_thetaL by hand. This would shorten the repeated case-split proofs of thetaL_one, thetaL_C and thetaL_single in this file, and the same pattern in the other files that re-prove or re-name these lemmas.

evidence.excerpt: thetaL L f = single (1 : ℤ) (1 : L) * LaurentSeries.derivative L f
